meta.scope: Correct S048 simulated-nCAP accuracy and within-dataset split; preserve no-human boundary

records.title: Selective peripheral nerve recording using simulated human median nerve activity and convolutional neural networks

decisions.notes: Cadaver-derived human median-nerve geometry is used only to generate simulated nCAPs. Reported accuracy and mean +/- SD concern simulated fascicle-source classification, not recorded human ECAP, pain or SCS response; no in-vivo human participants or external human validation.

updates.производительность: Simulated fascicle-source nCAP classification only: ESCAPE-NET accuracy 97.8 +/- 0.1% for 3 classes at 5% noise and 52.5 +/- 0.3% for 10 classes at 15% noise (Abstract); no in-vivo human validation.
updates.ограничения: Finite-element median-nerve simulation with simplified homogeneous geometry, fixed 56-channel interface, Gaussian noise and non-overlapping nCAPs. No in-vivo human signals, patient split, ECAP, pain or SCS outcome. Methods report threefold within-simulation cross-validation, not clinical external validation.
